scope: All 52 active questions that had a problem visual before the v54 rewrite
criterion: A visual must not disclose the correct option by simple transcription, maximum/minimum comparison, or a threshold that is printed next to the measured value. Legitimate visuals require calculation, masked-label knowledge, domain inference, diagnostic reasoning, denominator awareness, or process/analytical knowledge.

rewriteReasons.G12: The former correct option simply calculated and restated percentages visible from a small table; rewritten to require weighted aggregation, denominator awareness, and a causality caveat.
rewriteReasons.G34: The former correct option was mostly the visible NO2 ranking plus a basic source fact; rewritten as a multi-pollutant source-diagnosis question with limits on causal attribution.
rewriteReasons.G35: The former chart visibly gave the under-10-billion-t-CO2 statement; rewritten to require reduction-rate calculation and GWP/CO2-equivalent knowledge, following the pattern of recent official exams.
rewriteReasons.G38: The former table printed every waste category and treatment percentage beside its name, so all five choices could be decided by direct comparison; labels are now masked and must be identified from current official statistics.
rewriteReasons.W12: The former table printed both measured DO and the applicable threshold in the same row; rewritten to require daily-average calculation plus recall of the current class thresholds.
rewriteReasons.W39: Duplicated the W12 bottom-DO threshold-table task and supplied thresholds in the note; converted to a nonvisual official-style conceptual threshold/classification question.
rewriteReasons.H06: The former answer stated that the minimum occurred near pH 8 although the displayed minimum was at pH 9; rewritten to fix the inconsistency and require selection of an operating window plus amphoteric-redissolution reasoning.
